mappings.visualRationale: Visibly shows a glowing ethereal forcefield dome emitting a radiant purple-blue atmospheric corona and absorbing energy sparkles against a dark void, matching the Librarian of Leng's occult force barrier that absorbs and halves incoming damage.

Visibly shows a disembodied supernatural eyeball with an otherworldly purple pupil radiating undulating violet shadows and eldritch tendrils, depicting the master's supernatural eye manifesting at far range.

Visibly shows a menacing shadowy demonic countenance emerging from violet darkness with glowing cyan eyes and a terrifying jagged grin, cleanly portraying the horrifying psychic aura of fear that keeps nearby foes away.

Visibly shows a needle-thin violet-white psychic lance piercing through concentric purple wave rings and detonating in a blinding flash of white light, capturing the psychic penetration that deals damage and blinds a distant target.
Visibly shows a humanoid target silhouette violently pierced and impaled through the chest by a flying jagged projectile spike, directly representing Dremir's ranged impalement strike.
Visibly shows a glowing golden hourglass with grains of sand trickling slowly between bulbs amidst radiant magical sparks, capturing time dilation and reducing target movement speed to half.
